resize_view.note: the saved copy of the view the resize set-up 0x51fbc0 fills. Byte +5 set: the FX2 stores max(the records' first-scaler size, output size / (1 - margin)) at +0x3c/+0x3e (0xbd3a32). If that is more than the records give, the second scaler is handed a size the first scaler does not deliver (the L16 crash of 2026-11-26)

margin_words.note: 0xbd6f34 returns one of these u16 words (of 0x10000) when its mode arguments say so (SteadyShot Active: 7208, issue 5), 0 otherwise. The switch word does not turn it off (switch 3 with the margin applied); whether a margin is in use shows in the resize view: its first scaler above both the records' and the output's

dmm.note: unit objects of 0x50 bytes: +0 index u16, +2 flags u16 (bit 0 divided), +8 base u64, +0x10 offset, +0x14 size, +0x20 parent object, +0x24 key, +0x28 owner handle, +0x30 group it is divided as (build/dmm_dump.py, A7 IV layout; on the FX2 the unit objects' offset +0x107e0 was confirmed by the first test's L13 report)

output_records.note: 0x51cb38 / 0x51cc58 (FX2): records 1-3 choose their buffer id from w x h x factor: type 1 -> 0x4c3 below 3,317,761 bytes else 0x4c4; type 2 -> 0x69c below it else 0x2d9 with the log line FW: error! rc_out[%d] image data size excerrd mem size; otherwise for 0x295/0x43f/0x2d9: 13,271,041 or more -> 0x43f (no row in the FX2 DmmCfg.bin), more than 3,317,760 -> 0x2d9, else 0x295
